scope: All 18 existing Majarra Wave games; visual production only

production_rules.thumbnail_policy: Intentional square edit from the approved cover, with a game-specific focal crop; regenerate separately if the crop fails QA
production_rules.completion_policy: Compose each game's approved hero art into a game-specific completion treatment; do not generate a generic completion image
production_rules.system_icon_policy: Retain familiar Flutter system icons for back, close, volume, repeat, retry, and accessibility. Create game-specific treatment only for child-facing gameplay commands and targets.
production_rules.empty_loading_error_policy: Use the shared Majarra system treatment plus the game's hero token. Do not generate eighteen unrelated error illustrations.
production_rules.background_policy: Keep boards quiet and low-contrast behind interactive pieces; preschool boards use the simplest compositions.

shared_prompt_contract.brand: Majarra child-friendly premium children's game illustration
shared_prompt_contract.style: polished 2D storybook game art, rounded readable silhouettes, soft dimensional shading, clean edges, coherent line treatment
shared_prompt_contract.purpose: the object must be immediately recognizable during gameplay and remain clear at small mobile size
shared_prompt_contract.framing: single clear focal subject, generous breathing room, no cropped important edges
shared_prompt_contract.camera: front or gentle three-quarter view, no dramatic perspective distortion
shared_prompt_contract.simplicity: low visual clutter, no tiny decorative details, strong separation between subject and background
shared_prompt_contract.text_rule: no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols that resemble writing
shared_prompt_contract.rights_rule: no logos, no branded characters, no watermark, no signature
shared_prompt_contract.transparency_rule: for standalone objects use a plain removable background and preserve the complete silhouette for background removal
